variants.name: TASK-436.03
variants.summary: Live pane connections, presentation state and board announcements

nodes.name: HTTP application
nodes.responsibility: Composes the middleware and mounts every route on the one application

nodes.name: Application lifetime
nodes.responsibility: Boots and stops the server: the vault and loopback refusals, the pidfile, the ordered shutdown

nodes.name: Semantic board store
nodes.responsibility: The one place a board is read or written

nodes.name: Pane registry
nodes.responsibility: The sockets, what each pane is showing, and the news broadcast to every one of them

nodes.name: Disk change watcher
nodes.responsibility: Notices a board changed on disk that this process did not write

nodes.name: Codex workbench
nodes.responsibility: Owns the private Codex child and bridges it to the panes

nodes.name: Agent CLI
nodes.responsibility: Sends every board operation over HTTP and never writes a vault file itself

nodes.name: Browser
nodes.responsibility: Reads boards, says what each pane is showing, and writes nothing

nodes.name: Pane routes
nodes.responsibility: What each pane shows and where, pushed by the browser; the CLI opens, closes and shows panes through it

nodes.name: Pane socket
nodes.responsibility: One socket per page: registers it with the panes, notes which browser tab it belongs to, and passes its agent messages to the Codex workbench

nodes.name: Board lease
nodes.responsibility: One writer at a time per board: the lease file in the vault, an agent's claim, and news when the holder changes
nodes.description: ADR 0016. The lease lives beside the board, so every server on the vault sees the same exclusion.

nodes.name: Board announcements
nodes.responsibility: Tells every pane on a board who holds it and what they said they were doing
nodes.description: ADR 0022: a claim is visible wherever the board is shown. Board content is never in the news; a pane reads the board again.

nodes.name: Change feed
nodes.responsibility: Every settled board change as one stream with a cursor, read off the panes' announcements, for the agent's context

nodes.name: Tab session presence
nodes.responsibility: Which browser tab each pane on screen belongs to, and the end of a tab that no pane came back to within 60 seconds
nodes.description: A socket names its tab in its address, and both panes of one tab name the same one. It lives as long as the server process, so a tab that was present before a Codex child restart is still present after it.

nodes.name: Archboard server
nodes.responsibility: The one process that serves the vault: its routes, the one write boundary and the panes; callers reach it through the routes and the socket it handles
nodes.description: The server routines around the live pane subsystem: board mutations, claims, health and the agent brief. The pane implementation remains inside this same application.

nodes.name: HTTP listener
nodes.responsibility: The one Express application and the HTTP server that answers for it

nodes.name: Server entry
nodes.responsibility: The process entry that archboard start spawns: it starts the server and reports a startup failure

nodes.name: Browser origin guard
nodes.responsibility: Checks browser request origins at HTTP and WebSocket entry points

beats.heading: The socket owns screen presence
beats.body: Only the authoritative socket owns a pane identity. Its close removes pane and tab presence; a replaced socket cannot retire its successor.

beats.heading: News carries a version, never the board
beats.body: A board write, claim or disk change reaches the panes through announcements. The pane reads content again from the store; no pane owns a board copy.

beats.heading: Agents read the same news
beats.body: The change feed records each board broadcast and lets the workbench read changes since its cursor. Tab presence allows a reload to keep its conversation.
